## Summary

**C2P** (Chunky to Planair): Chunky to planar conversion.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `bit re-order source → d` |
| Syntax | `C2P <vea>,d` |
| Short | Chunky to planar conversion. |
| Description | Chunky-to-Planar conversion, bit-wise transpose. Planar-to-Chunky conversion is the same as Chunky-to-Planar. From a 8 byte source all bits from place n are put in destination byte n, in the order of source. So all msb are placed in the top byte of the destination and the lsb are all placed in the lowest byte. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | `0` |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | `0000` |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00101000` |

### Example

```asm
    c2p    d0,d1
```

```text
vea d0: FE 00 00 00 00 00 00 07
Result:
d d1: 80 80 80 80 80 81 81 01
```

- ($FE=%1111 1110 , $07=%0000 0111)

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no C2P. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
